data.name: Bleeding Wound
data.description: At 11th level, when the swashbuckler hits a living creature with a light or one-handed piercing melee weapon attack, she can spend 1 panache point as a free action to have that attack deal extra %1 bleed damage. Alternatively, the swashbuckler can spend 2 panache points to deal 1 point of Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution bleed damage (swashbuckler's choice) instead. Creatures that are immune to sneak attacks are also immune to these types of bleed damage.|BleedingWoundDamage
